passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis provides information concerning our results of operations and financial condition. This discussion should be read in conjunction with our accompanying consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto. See note 4 in the accompanying consolidated financial statements for an overview of accounting standards that we have adopted or that we plan to adopt that have had or may have an impact on our financial statements. Overview Liberty, through its subsidiaries, is primarily engaged in the motorsport and live entertainment industries. Formula 1 is a wholly-owned subsidiary and is also a reportable segment. Formula 1 is a global motorsports business that holds exclusive commercial rights with respect to the Federation Internationale de l’Automobile (“FIA”) Formula One World Championship (the “F1 Championship”), an annual, approximately nine-month long, motor race-based competition in which teams compete for the Constructors' Championship and drivers compete for the Drivers' Championship. The F1 Championship takes place on various circuits with a varying number of events (“Formula 1 Events”) taking place in different countries around the world each season. Formula 1 is responsible for the commercial exploitation and development of the F1 Championship as well as various aspects of its management and administration. On July 3, 2025, the Company acquired approximately 84% of the equity interests in MotoGP Sports Entertainment Group, S.L. (formerly, Dorna Sports, S.L.) (“MotoGP”) for a preliminary purchase price of approximately $3,659 million (approximately €3,122 million) . MotoGP, a reportable segment, is a global motorsports business that holds exclusive commercial rights to the Fédération Internationale de Motocyclisme (“FIM”) Grand Prix World Championship (the “MotoGP Championship”), an annual, approximately nine-month long, motorcycle racing competition in which riders compete for the Riders’ Championship, teams (the “MotoGP Teams”) compete for the Teams’ Championship and engine manufacturers compete for the Manufacturers’ Championship. MotoGP is responsible for the commercial exploitation and development of the MotoGP Championship. Our “Corporate and Other” category includes corporate expenses and investments and related financial instruments in other companies. QuintEvents, LLC (“QuintEvents”) was a consolidated subsidiary of the Company and was included in “Corporate and Other” until the Liberty Live Split-Off (defined below). Braves Holdings, LLC ("Braves Holdings") was a consolidated subsidiary of the Company and was included in “Corporate and Other” until the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off (defined below). The Company previously had a tracking stock structure. A tracking stock is a type of common stock that the issuing company intends to reflect or “track” the economic performance of a particular business or “group,” rather than the economic performance of the company as a whole. The Company completed the transactions disclosed below to separate certain collections of businesses, assets and liabilities into separate publicly traded companies. credit_strengths.text: Formula One's exclusive commercial rights to the FIA World Championship generate predictable, contracted revenue across a roughly nine-month season, and the MotoGP acquisition adds a second global motorsport platform with similar rights-based economics. This diversification should support revenue durability and pricing power through the annual event cycle.

Operating income and EBITDA proxy cover gross interest expense at a moderate multiple, and the current ratio exceeds the sector median, indicating adequate near-term liquidity. Cash on hand provides a buffer against seasonal working-capital swings in the live-events business.

key_risks.text: The MotoGP acquisition consumed a large cash outlay and added subsidiary credit facilities, lifting total debt materially year over year. Integration risk and the need to service both Formula One and MotoGP debt stacks could pressure cash flow if event attendance or sponsorship renewals weaken.

A convertible note matures in the near term, and the debt maturity profile shows a substantial bullet in the second year alongside smaller annual amortization. Refinancing this note at maturity will depend on market conditions and the issuer's equity price, given the fair-value option accounting.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Gross leverage sits above the sector median and the indicative financial risk profile is aggressive, leaving limited headroom before the next threshold. A moderate EBITDA decline or incremental debt raise could push leverage toward the downgrade trigger, constraining financial flexibility.

Interest coverage is below the sector median, and operating cash flow is not available in the data bundle, so free cash flow to debt cannot be assessed. This gap is material because it prevents a full view of the issuer's ability to service debt from internally generated funds.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer's credit profile is supported by durable, rights-based motorsport revenue and a safe Altman Z double-prime zone, but leverage above the sector median and an aggressive indicative risk profile temper the view. Deleveraging depends on EBITDA growth from MotoGP integration and disciplined capital allocation.

Analyst judgement: refinancing the convertible note and managing the second-year maturity are key near-term tests. If MotoGP synergies materialize and free cash flow remains robust, leverage could trend toward the upgrade threshold; otherwise, the issuer may face negative rating pressure.

credit_strengths.text: Formula One 對 FIA 世界錦標賽嘅獨家商業權利，喺大約九個月嘅賽季內產生可預測、已簽約嘅收入，而收購 MotoGP 增添咗第二個全球賽車運動平台，具有類似嘅權利型經濟效益。呢種多元化應有助支持收入持久性同定價能力，貫穿年度賽事週期。
營運收入同 EBITDA 代理指標以溫和倍數覆蓋總利息支出，而流動比率高於行業中位數，顯示短期流動性充足。手頭現金為現場活動業務嘅季節性營運資金波動提供緩衝。

key_risks.text: 收購 MotoGP 消耗咗大量現金支出，並增加咗附屬公司信貸融資，令總債務按年大幅上升。整合風險以及需要同時償付 Formula One 同 MotoGP 債務堆疊，可能喺賽事入場人數或贊助續約轉弱時對現金流構成壓力。
可換股票據喺短期內到期，而債務到期結構顯示第二年有大量一次性還款，同時伴隨較小嘅年度攤銷。喺到期時為呢張票據再融資，將取決於市場狀況同發行人嘅股價，因為涉及公允價值期權會計。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 總槓桿高於行業中位數，而指示性財務風險狀況為進取，令喺下一個門檻之前嘅緩衝空間有限。EBITDA 溫和下降或增量債務融資，可能將槓桿推向降級觸發點，限制財務靈活性。
利息覆蓋率低於行業中位數，而數據包中並無營運現金流，因此無法評估自由現金流對債務嘅比率。呢個缺口屬重大，因為佢阻礙全面了解發行人以內部產生資金償付債務嘅能力。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人嘅信貸狀況受到持久、權利型賽車運動收入同安全嘅 Altman Z 雙重素數區間支持，但槓桿高於行業中位數同進取嘅指示性風險狀況令觀點有所緩和。去槓桿取決於 MotoGP 整合帶來嘅 EBITDA 增長同紀律性資本配置。
分析師判斷：為可換股票據再融資同管理第二年到期係關鍵嘅短期考驗。如果 MotoGP 協同效應實現，而自由現金流保持強勁，槓桿可能趨向升級門檻；否則，發行人可能面臨負面評級壓力。
